regions.summary: Counted CHR stream storage: little-endian output-byte count followed by tokens. $01..$3F repeats one following byte; $40..$7F emits zeroes ($40 means 128, others use low six bits); $81..$FF copies low-seven-bit literals; $00/$80 skips. Output count ends decoding even mid-run. Each root stays within its selected 16-KiB bank; partial final literal suffixes are separately preserved. NES tiles use two eight-byte bit planes.
